instagram.caption:
Final Fantasy was meant to be its creator's last game.

In 1987 Hironobu Sakaguchi's games weren't selling. He decided that if this one failed, he would quit the industry and go back to university.

It became a hit instead and saved his career. There are now 16 main Final Fantasy games.

Which one is your favorite?
